# Hotel Yogiraj & Hotel Yogiraj NX, Shirdi

> Hotel Yogiraj (Main Building) and Hotel Yogiraj NX (Building 2) are premier budget-friendly and family hotels located on Pimpalwadi Road, just 300 meters (2-minute walk) from the sacred Shri Sai Baba Samadhi Mandir in Shirdi, Maharashtra, India. Offering comfortable AC and Non-AC rooms, family suites, pure vegetarian in-house restaurant, elevator (in NX), complimentary Wi-Fi, free private car parking, and 24-hour pilgrimage front-desk assistance.

## Properties

- [Hotel Yogiraj (Main Building)](https://yogirajhotel.com/): Long-standing comfortable hotel located 300m from Sai Baba Temple Gate 2. Features 7 room categories from double bed to spacious family rooms, pure vegetarian dining, and private parking. Direct Desk: +91 95955 33535.
- [Hotel Yogiraj NX (Building 2)](https://yogirajhotel.com/yogiraj-nx): Modern second building on Pimpalwadi Road featuring elevator service, luxury suites with private bathtubs, spacious six-bedroom family suites with dual washrooms, and pure vegetarian dining. Direct Desk: +91 99030 33535.

## Key Information

- **Address**: Pimpalwadi Rd, near Sai Baba Temple, near Sai Sh corner, Shiv Nagar, Shirdi, Maharashtra 423109, India
- **Geo Coordinates**: Latitude 19.76695517, Longitude 74.48043686
- **Distance to Temple**: 300 meters (2-minute flat walk to Gate 2 / Pimpalwadi entrance)
- **Check-in Time**: 12:00 PM (Early check-in subject to availability)
- **Check-out Time**: 11:00 AM
- **Hotel Yogiraj Main Desk**: +91 95955 33535
- **Hotel Yogiraj NX Direct Desk**: +91 99030 33535
- **Email**: info@yogirajhotel.com
- **Official Website**: https://yogirajhotel.com
- **Hotel Yogiraj NX Section**: https://yogirajhotel.com/yogiraj-nx

## Accommodations

### Hotel Yogiraj (Main Building)
- **Double Bed Non-AC**: Budget-friendly room for 2 guests with queen bed, private bathroom, and free Wi-Fi.
- **Double Bed AC**: Climate-controlled room for 2 guests with air conditioning, TV, hot water, and complimentary Wi-Fi.
- **Triple Bed AC & Non-AC**: Comfortable room accommodating up to 3 guests with 1 double bed and 1 single bed.
- **Four Bed Family Room AC & Non-AC**: Spacious family room accommodating 4 guests with 2 large double beds.

### Hotel Yogiraj NX (Building 2)
- **Double Bed AC Room**: Contemporary AC room with premium linen, LED TV, intercom, and ensuite bathroom for 2 guests.
- **Triple Bed AC Room**: Well-appointed room for 3 guests with 1 double and 1 single bed.
- **Suite Room with Bathtub**: Premium luxury suite featuring a private bathtub, spacious living area, king bed, and deluxe amenities.
- **Six-Bedroom Family Suite with 2 Washrooms**: Large family suite accommodating up to 6 to 8 guests with dual full washrooms, ideal for extended family pilgrimages.

## Amenities & Services

- **Proximity**: Only 300 meters from Shri Sai Baba Temple.
- **Elevator**: Modern passenger elevator service available at Hotel Yogiraj NX.
- **Dining**: In-house pure vegetarian restaurant serving North Indian, South Indian, Maharashtrian thalis, and tea/coffee.
- **Internet**: High-speed complimentary Wi-Fi across all rooms and public areas.
- **Parking**: On-site secure car and coach parking available for guests.
- **Front Desk**: 24-hour reception, luggage storage, temple aarti schedule guidance, and taxi arrangements.
- **Power**: 24-hour power backup for continuous comfort.

## Nearby Landmarks & Distances

- **Shri Sai Baba Samadhi Temple**: 300 meters (2-minute walk)
- **Dwarkamai & Chavadi**: 350 meters (3-minute walk)
- **Gurusthan**: 300 meters (2-minute walk)
- **Wet N Joy Water Park**: 1.2 km (4-minute drive)
- **Sai Teerth Devotional Theme Park**: 1.5 km (5-minute drive)
- **Shirdi Bus Depot (MSRTC)**: 800 meters (10-minute walk / 3-minute auto)
- **Sainagar Shirdi Railway Station (SNSI)**: 3.2 km (8-minute drive)
- **Shirdi International Airport (SAG)**: 14 km (25-minute drive)
- **Shani Shingnapur**: 72 km (1.5-hour drive — taxi assistance available at reception)
